// note: Compiles Casino Games (web/src/**/*.ts) to web/dist/*.js via tsgo. The pure-TS engine lives in the shared spine package @axiom/web-engine (no wasm); it resolves to that package's built declarations for typecheck, and the emitted JS keeps the bare specifier, resolved by the import map axiom-serve injects (dev) or inlined by a packager. Tests (*.test.ts) are excluded — they run under `node --test` with native TS type-stripping (no DOM), so they need no compile here. So are the test-only support modules (*.testkit.ts, the repo's existing name for a fake): `games/headless-canvas2d.testkit.ts` stubs a browser so a node test can run a game on the real Canvas2D rasterizer, and it must never be shipped to a real one.
